svg.title: Perfume Review Analyzer
svg.desc: Postcard for Perfume Review Analyzer (nlp & machine learning, Python): Finds what buyers care about in a synthetic set of Turkish perfume reviews, using BERT sentiment and clustering. Turkish BERT sentiment and aspect-based analysis. Ranks the features that drive satisfaction. K-Means consumer segments with profiles. Built with Python, Transformers, PyTorch, scikit-learn.
